tuples.quote: 351. A bank shall adhere to the following instructions for charging penal charges in respect of all the fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards.

tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: In case of existing loans, the switchover to new penal charges regime shall be applicable from June 30, 2024.
